title: fix: show agent owners why a deploy or MCP server failed
author: voodoohop

gist.summary: Failed code-agent deployments and deletions now include Cloudflare's error message instead of only a status code. Cloudflare 400 responses return 400; other failures return 502. Error messages are capped at 1,000 characters, account IDs are redacted, and failures without a usable message retain the status-code fallback. Agent runs now name the MCP server that failed to load and log an MCP_SERVER_FAILED warning. The always-run model compatibility suite now checks apps/agent-*/agent.json and code-agent.json against the agents API's strict input schemas, catching invalid or unknown config fields before those files are used to create agents.
